hook: Jeff Geerling now serves time to the world
hookText: Jeff Geerling joins the NTP Pool

beats.say: Jeff Geerling has joined the global NTP Pool with a public Stratum 2 time server, fed by his own Stratum 1 Raspberry Pi in the studio.
That Pi uses a TimeHAT and a timing-grade u-blox GNSS module with an outdoor antenna, while a separate public server keeps his home address private.
His advice: you don't need GNSS to contribute, but you do need long-term uptime, good time and a stable IP, because traffic can linger for years.
